title: @csp/label assisted labeling + multi-annotator consensus + calibration + label provenance
context: Human verification is central to citizen-science quality. @csp/label provides assisted labeling and multi-annotator consensus with calibration on known-answer items and full label provenance. For v1 the consensus is weighted-majority (a Dawid-Skene/EM upgrade is deferred to the backlog given cold-start sparsity). Depends on csp-validate-005.
objective: Implement @csp/label assisted labeling with multi-annotator consensus (weighted-majority v1), calibration on known-answer items, and recorded label provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: Assisted labeling workflow with multi-annotator consensus (weighted-majority for v1)
Calibration on known-answer items and recorded per-annotator agreement
Label provenance recorded for every label (who/what/when/rule)
Deterministic and tested on synthetic data; pnpm build/test/lint pass
output: A PR adding the @csp/label package with assisted labeling, consensus, calibration, and label provenance.
